Resident should re-enroll. | Contact UIDAI helpline for re-enrollment. | Aadhaar number has been cancelled by UIDAI. |   | 997  | Aadhaar number is suspended or not active  | Handle suspended Aadhaar status gracefully  | Aadhaar status is not active.
